name: Kirishima Honoka
source:
A stubborn and skeptical girl

A flashy looking high school girl who wears an orange hair clip and customizes her uniform to match her tastes.
She was once a victim of a harrowing assault with her former best friend, but is haunted by her decision to abandon her and run away...

"We're just strangers. Suspicion is what makes us human."

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
